name: AWS Console
tagline: The classic maze — regions, services, IAM. Easy to get lost.
firstWin: the right region selected and the EC2 dashboard open
path: sign in to the console (root or IAM user)
check the region selector, top right — pick the closest region
search for the service you need in the top search bar (e.g. EC2)
optional: Setting up billing alerts and an IAM user instead of root is good hygiene, but not needed to look around.

knowledge.text: The region selector is top-right. Resources are region-specific — if something you created 'disappears', check you're in the same region you made it in.
Avoid using the root account for daily work. Create an IAM user with appropriate permissions and sign in as that instead.
The top search bar jumps to any service by name — type 'EC2', 'S3', 'Lambda' etc. rather than hunting the menu.
